source: Property audit of godot-road-generator (github.com/TheDuckCow/godot-road-generator) addons/road-generator/nodes/*.gd + procgen/*.gd. RoadKit Godot adds the [roadkit] entries.

scene_tree.children: RoadContainer (one per road) > RoadPoint chain; RoadIntersection nodes are detected automatically and own RoadLane legs

nodes.description: Scene root (GRG road_manager.gd). Groups all containers, holds global defaults.

properties.name: auto_junction
properties.hint: [roadkit] detect crossings / T / endpoint joins automatically

nodes.description: One road (GRG road_container.gd). Chains RoadPoints, sweeps the procedural mesh, hosts GLB props.

properties.name: create_geo
properties.hint: GRG: false = custom mesh (GLB prefab) replaces the procedural surface

properties.name: use_lowpoly_preview
properties.hint: GRG: divide loop density while dragging

properties.name: draw_lanes_editor
properties.hint: GRG: lane debug curves in editor

properties.name: material_resource
properties.hint: GRG: surface material applied over geometry (texture on top)

properties.name: edge_rp_locals
properties.hint: GRG join table: local exit RoadPoints

properties.name: edge_rp_targets
properties.hint: GRG join table: neighbor container points

nodes.description: One cross-section on the chain (GRG road_point.gd). Position + Bezier magnitudes + full cross-section.

properties.name: position
properties.hint: x east, y elevation, z south (meters)

properties.name: prior_mag
properties.hint: Bezier handle toward the previous point (GRG prior_mag)

properties.name: next_mag
properties.hint: Bezier handle toward the next point (GRG next_mag)

properties.name: median
properties.hint: [roadkit] physical center median width (GRG DIVIDER alignment)

properties.name: auto_join
properties.hint: [roadkit] endpoint snaps to neighbors within snap_m

nodes.description: Detected automatically where 2+ roads meet (GRG road_intersection.gd + procgen/intersection_ngon.gd). Classification follows the plugin's two tracks: procedural n-gon crossing, or roundabout ring.

properties.name: mode
properties.hint: [roadkit] force the junction type (auto follows detection)

nodes.description: Lane path through an intersection (GRG road_lane.gd). Left/right neighbor tags drive turn connectivity.
